pixel_description: Render only: concrete deck slab horizontal on top, two dark vertical I-girders/columns to ground left and right supporting deck. Critical part transverse cross-beam xb: ONE element, single dark steel I-beam, horizontal transverse, spanning between girders, clamped at both ends with top and web bolt groups. Under bottom flange: two hanging twin units side-by-side centre. Each unit: one vertical coil spring + one vertical silver viscous damper cylinder side-by-side, top attached via black hanger bracket to beam, bottom pinned to top of large black box tuned mass. So 2 masses, 2 springs, 2 dampers total. Black open cage stops: one hanging under beam near left girder, one hanging under beam near right girder, plus small cage on outer side of each mass moving with mass. Small black box deck accelerometer on top centre of deck with wire. Standing adult man right of right girder for scale. How touch: hb bolts clamp xb ends to girder webs, xb bottom touches spring/damper tops via brackets, spring/damper bottoms touch mass tops, masses float with air gap to beam and to under-beam cages, deck touches girders top and ac bottom.

comparison_with_previous: First evaluation; no previous render to compare.

deviations.measured: both spring tops and damper tops attached to beam bottom flange via black hanger brackets with no gap
deviations.expected: xb transverse beam bottom to touch tops of cs springs and vd dampers (hangs springs/dampers)
deviations.why: pixels show direct bracket attachment under beam for both twin units; segmenter 'apart' is threshold on bracket vs coil/cylinder, not a physical gap. Load path girders->xb->cs/vd intact.

deviations.measured: vertical long-axis coils, about 1.2x tm box height, attached to xb via hanger
deviations.expected: cs vertical long axis, about 0.6x tm height, touching xb
deviations.why: pixels show two long vertical coil springs above the two black masses. Segmenter 'horizontal' is wrong - coils are clearly vertical. Taller than 0.6x is illustration of stroke/sag, does not change vertical suspension working principle, and contact to xb is present.

deviations.measured: vertical long-axis cylinders above masses, attached to xb via hanger
deviations.expected: vd vertical long axis, touching xb
deviations.why: pixels show two vertical silver viscous cylinders parallel to springs. Segmenter 'horizontal' is wrong. Contact to xb via top bracket and to tm via bottom pin is visible, so damping path intact.

deviations.measured: 5 detected bolt groups, many bolts at both beam ends top and web
deviations.expected: hb HSFG clamp bolt set qty 1 set, 2 visible zones (beam-to-girder each end)
deviations.why: pixels show multiple rows of bolts at left and right beam-to-girder joints. Extra bolt depictions vs 2 zones is set detailing; more bolts is conservative for 32.9 kN slip vs 13.1 kN demand and does not change clamp working principle.

deviations.measured: 3-4 black cage stops visible: 2 hanging under beam near girders plus 1 side cage on each tuned mass
deviations.expected: es caged elastomer stops qty 1 set, 2 visible
deviations.why: pixels show cage baskets under beam and on mass sides. Extra cages vs 2 still provide over-travel limit for 49.4 mm stroke inside 80 mm gap; does not create different mechanism.
pixels show the instance as vertical coil spring; segmenter horizontal call is wrong, same as cs.
pixels show the instance as vertical damper cylinder; segmenter horizontal call is wrong, same as vd.

deviations.measured: located parts span ~5090 mm across x ~3222 mm high scaled by ~1700 mm person; xb ~1.3x spec, spring+mass hang ~1.2-1.5 m tall ~2x spec
deviations.expected: whole device largest part xb 2500-3000 mm, hanging envelope 124 mm sag+stroke within girder depth, zero above deck except 10-50 mm ac
deviations.why: pixels show deck on two tall girder-columns to ground for visualization with twin masses hanging below beam between girders, ac small box on deck. Beam length modestly over but not many-times; tall hang is illustration, still under-deck twin-hang shape with no deck change. Does not break 2% weight or Medium comfort limits and not a shape the problem rules out.

s1_differences: 3D geometry has correct parts, counts and connections: 1 xb, 2 tm, 2 cs vertical, 2 vd vertical, hb clamps, es cages, ac on deck. But annotated picture contradicts solution text locations: Coil Spring Suspension and Viscous Damper callouts both point to travel-stop cages, and Clamp Bolt Set points to beam, so labels misidentify parts.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed in image: load path main girders->xb->springs/dampers->masses visible with no interference, masses clear of beam and stops in static view, clamp at both ends can carry 7.85 kN plus dynamics. Extra bolts/cages are conservative, not impossible assembly.
notes: Leader lines are faint; endpoints judged from visible dots/lines. 3D geometry matches twin under-deck TMD but three callout leaders end on wrong parts.
